# Deepesh Singh — AI Product Engineer

Deepesh Singh is a B.Tech Robotics student seeking AI Engineering and AI Backend Engineering internships for 2027. His interests include RAG, AI agents, and reliable backend systems.

## Portfolio implementation

This portfolio uses Next.js App Router and React. It includes a reusable project configuration, an interactive capability map, a technical journal, and a deterministic fallback for the portfolio assistant.

## Niramaya AI

Niramaya AI is a medical document processing and retrieval project. The public repository includes a Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL models and migrations, document processing, chunking, embeddings, and optional Qdrant retrieval. The portfolio case study separates repository implementation from unverified runtime services.

Case study: /projects/niramaya-ai
Source: https://github.com/singhdeepesh20/Niramaya-AI

No live deployment, clinical validation, measured user outcomes, or retrieval benchmark results are claimed.
